text:
Maya S.: Heads-up — candidate for 2nd-round SRE (4/12 11:30a) just asked to move to 12:00. Can we merge the 11:30 slot with the 12:00 panel?
Devon K.: I’m on the 12:00 panel, fine with merging if folks can stay. who’s on 11:30?
Priya R.: I’m on 11:30 and can shift to 12. free for the extra 30m.
Samir P.: I can’t do 12:00 — back-to-back meeting. any backups?
Maya S.: @Samir P. — could you do async debrief instead? we can capture your notes in the form.
Samir P.: yeah, ok. will fill debrief form right after. what’s the quick link?
Interview Bot: Reminder: Debrief form for interviews: https://intranet/reviews/debrief (please submit within 1h of panel).
Maya S.: Thanks. Two asks: 1) confirm merge so calendar update goes out 2) quick rubric check — lead asked we weigh system design 30% (not default).
Devon K.: Confirmed merge OK from me.
Priya R.: confirmed.
Samir P.: confirmed async.
Maya S.: Scheduling note: I’ll update the invite to 12:00-1:00 and add a line: "Panel merged — Samir will submit async debrief"
Maya S.: Rubric tweak — adding weight override. Quick paste of updated weights: 
```
Execution: 40%
System design: 30%
Debugging: 20%
Collaboration: 10%
```
Devon K.: Fine by me. can we add one line in debrief form: "Did candidate communicate tradeoffs? y/n + 1-2 bullets"
Priya R.: love that. saves follow-up.
Maya S.: will patch the form. Samir, for async debrief please include: scoring per section + 1 sentence summary + any blockers.
Samir P.: got it — I’ll submit after my meeting.
Maya S.: final check — anyone needs a different timezone window? the candidate is PST, panel now at 12:00 PT.
Devon K.: good for me.
Priya R.: good. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
Interview Bot: Calendar updated: 12:00-13:00 PT. Invite sent to panel + candidate.
Maya S.: perfect — closing loop. I’ll post short recap in candidate thread and pin the debrief link.
